tags: why do dogs kick after pooping
script: Your dog just pooped and immediately started kicking dirt everywhere like a tiny lunatic. It's not cleanup, and it's not embarrassment. There are scent glands in your dog's paws, and that kicking motion releases their own personal scent right next to the mark they just left. It's basically a billboard for other dogs, broadcasting who was here, when, and that this is their territory. The visual scratch marks matter too, they're easy for other dogs to spot from a distance, even after the smell fades. Dogs with more confidence tend to do it more often, so if your dog is an aggressive little dirt-kicking machine, that's a pretty good sign they feel like they own the place. Completely normal, deeply territorial. Want more real dog behavior insight? The link's below.
